chunks.title: XCOMB aluminium honeycomb panels
chunks.text: The intelligence within Extraordinary, at the core. Discover INOX XCOMB aluminium honeycomb panels. A cellular core brings a different approach to panel construction, opening possibilities for considered interior surfaces. A cellular foundation An aluminium honeycomb core sits between outer layers, creating a sandwich panel structure inspired by the efficiency of a honeycomb. A surface for your vision Explore panel possibilities for furniture, cabinetry and interior features. The right finish and construction depend on your application. Details that make the difference Talk to our team about panel sizes, available finishes, edge details and suitability before specifying XCOMB for your project.

chunks.title: INOX privacy policy
chunks.text: How INOX handles website account details, product enquiries, cookies and your privacy requests. When you create a website account, we collect your name, email address, country code, mobile number, optional company name and account consent. We store a password hash rather than your original password. When you send an enquiry, we collect the contact and project details you provide, your message, selected products, variations and quantities. Enquiries sent while signed in are linked to your account so you can revisit them. We use your details to create and secure your account, provide signed-in access to product prices, save your enquiries, respond to project requests and manage follow-up. Account records also help us maintain the website and investigate misuse. We record website registration, successful sign-ins, sign-outs and enquiry submissions. Authorised website administrators can view customer contact details, account activity, valid session counts and enquiries to manage website services and customer requests. Customers can access enquiries linked to their own account. Entering an email address into a guest enquiry does not automatically attach it to an account. We use an essential session cookie to keep you signed in. Customer sessions expire after seven days unless you sign out earlier. This cookie is HTTP-only, so website scripts cannot read it. You can remove cookies and local storage through your browser settings; doing so may sign you out or clear your selections. Hosting and database services process information as part of operating this website. Information submitted in an enquiry is available to the team handling that request. Disclosure may also be necessary to meet applicable requirements or protect the service from misuse. External websites linked from this site have their own privacy practices. Review their policies before sharing information with them. Account and enquiry information is retained to provide account services, handle customer requests and meet applicable record-keeping needs. Browser-stored selections remain until you remove them or clear your browser storage. We use password hashing, session checks and access controls to protect website account information. No online service can guarantee absolute security. Keep your password private and sign out when using a shared device. You can sign out at any time and view your saved enquiries from My account.
